questions.question_text: What is the difference between bar graphs, divided bar graphs and histograms? [3]

keywords_required: Bar graphs show categorical data with gaps between the bars.
Divided (stacked) bar graphs show categories sub-divided into components.
Histograms show continuous numerical data grouped into ranges (bins) with no gaps between the bars.

questions.question_text: A class have been researching how many people in their local town work in the primary, secondary and tertiary sector. Suggest a suitable way to present this data. [1]

A group of students have visited a local mine to identify how industry impacts the local environment. They have collected qualitative data in the form of words. Suggest how they could present this data. [1]

keywords_required: Word cloud, annotated photographs, or a quote bank.
